text: Eduardo Galeano's Open Veins of Latin America, published in 1971, was banned by military governments in Chile, Argentina and Uruguay. It was also banned in Brazil. No year is given for these bans.
meta_description: Open Veins of Latin America by Eduardo Galeano: banned by military governments in Chile, Argentina and Uruguay, and in Brazil, after its 1971 publication.
